Deploy a Render service (web service, worker, cron job). Can deploy specific commit (Git) or image tag (Docker). Optionally wait for deploy to complete.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA to deploy (Git-backed services only). Optional - uses latest commit if omitted.

image_url.description: Docker image URL with tag/digest (image-backed services only). Optional - uses :latest if omitted.

wait.description: Wait for deploy to complete before returning. Default: true

returns.description: Deploy details including deploy ID, status, start time, duration
